dedupe_keys.name: zindi lacuna solar survey satellite and drone images of madagascar with polygon annotations of solar panels and solar water heaters

description: The Lacuna Solar Survey Challenge on Zindi (February to March 2025), backed by Lacuna Fund, released a labelled image set for detecting and counting solar panels and solar water heaters in Madagascar. Contents: 3,312 training images and 1,107 test images from satellite and high-resolution drone imagery, each with polygon annotations of zones containing solar installations (a polygon may hold one or more objects) and metadata on image origin (satellite or drone) and placement (for example rooftop or terrace, open courtyard or garden). Annotation followed visual identification on low-resolution satellite images, field verification of about 25% of cases, acquisition of satellite and drone images and manual delineation by experts. Producer: Zindi challenge with Lacuna Fund. Coverage: sites in Madagascar. Format and access: images.zip, Train.csv and Test.csv with a starter notebook, downloaded from Zindi after joining the challenge. Licence: challenge data may be accessed, used and shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 according to the challenge rules. Caveats: polygons group installations, so object counts need care; sampling of sites is not described as nationally representative. Simulation uses: mapping distributed solar adoption for off-grid electrification planning and distribution network load and hosting capacity studies. Related records: data-google-open-buildings.
